description: Assign `deps 📦` and `bot 🤖` labels, and for major updates also `major ⚠️`. That last label is load-bearing: the shared Kodiak config in mheob/.github blocks merging on this exact string, U+FE0F included, so renaming it lets majors merge unreviewed. It is added with `addLabels` so a repository that sets its own `labels` keeps it.
